title: zwingera amara
intro: Zwingera amara, commonly known as Bitter Zwingera, is a plant species in the genus Zwingera. It is used as a medicinal herb in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Zwingera amara include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Zwingera amara include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
